linkedin_post:
"The best software doesn't add steps. It removes the ones nobody wanted to do."

I think about this quote every time we map out a new project with a client. 

Too many teams buy software that adds new fields, new logins, and new dashboards to check. They end up working for the tool, instead of the tool working for them.

Good custom software or automation should feel invisible. It takes the messy manual work—like moving data between your CRM and your billing app—and simply handles it in the background.

Before you buy another subscription, look at what your team is doing by hand right now. How can you remove a step instead of adding one?

Agree or disagree?
